newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids down on weak MGE.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids down on weak MGE.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat bids were steady to lower on Friday in very thin trade following Thursday's Thanksgiving Day holiday, cash grain dealers said.
"All the farmers pretty much took the day off and I'm about to do the same," one North Dakota dealer said.
Bids were not available at many country locations as elevators closed early.

MGE March spring wheat futures closed 5-1/2 cents per bushel lower in light dealings with commercials said to be sellers of the March in spread trading. The Dec/March spread closed at 41-1/2 cents per bushel.
